//: Capability manifest for <Toast> — svelte-pure-admin. See alert.map.json / badge.map.json for the model. Maps each NEUTRAL toast feature to this wrapper's prop, kind, and (for enums) the option set THIS component declares. svelte's toast has only the 5 severity variants (no secondary/light/dark). `filled` → isFilled; `show` → the bindable show prop (drives pa-toast--show). The icon slot presence drives the pa-toast__icon chip; svelte renders .pa-toast__title/.pa-toast__message/.pa-toast__close unconditionally. `close` maps to the onclose callback — svelte renders the close button regardless, so the passed value is inert under SSR but keeps the feature declared for the capability diff.
